descricao: In this activity, each adolescent is invited to look beyond outward appearance and discover what emerges behind the image. It is an exercise in creativity and self-esteem, where each girl recognizes her own ability to transform something simple into something beautiful and meaningful. The session was led by facilitator Leila Palmeira.

The Art Education Workshop uses modeling clay and colorful paints, creating a playful moment through creative painting. In addition to its educational value, the activity strengthens positive developmental bonds in children and encourages imagination and expression. The session was led by facilitator Tereza Santoianni.

In the Robotics Workshop, adolescents at Casa Menina Mulher began learning computational logic using cardboard boards and PET bottle caps, building a concrete foundation before applying the concepts on a digital platform. The session was led by instructor Américo Barros.
